messages.author: a3ea45e87285d820
messages.subject: Re: bug in the gl2snapp fuction?
parts:
Hi Jessica,

Not sure what is going on here. One difference between the two files is that gl2snapp labels the individuals with the specimen id and the population to which it is assigned, and the population labels are the id labels. This should not be a problem.

gl2snapp orders the data by population, so they are tidily aggregated, but that does not seem to be an issue.

The loci scores are different, for example

SA109 in the gl2snapp file is 102002.....
SA109 in the VCF version is 00000201 00 ......

So it seems like the order of the loci in the snapp file might be different (which I guess should not be a problem), or perhaps jumbled (which would be a problem).

Can you look at a few loci in both the dartR file

as.matrix(gl)[1:5,1:7]

and in your vcf file to see if they concur in their SNP scores.

A
